data.body:
AUDIT (broader hardening sweep — beyond initial cluster scope):

ID-resolution bypass surface in production code:

(1) ticket-lib-api.sh — _ticketlib_resolve_short_id only handles 8-hex; silently passes through jira-style/alias inputs unchanged. Used by EIGHT API functions (sub-agent identified four; audit found four more):
  - ticket_comment ✗
  - ticket_tag ✗
  - ticket_untag ✗
  - ticket_edit ✗
  - ticket_set_file_impact ✗ (NEW)
  - ticket_get_file_impact ✗ (NEW)
  - ticket_archive ✗ (NEW)
  - ticket_delete ✗ (NEW)

(2) ticket-lib.sh — ticket_read_status does raw dir check, no resolution. Called by ticket-transition.sh, ticket-create.sh, ticket-link.sh, ticket-lib-api.sh:ticket_create. ticket_transition appearing to 'work' for jira-style IDs is COINCIDENCE — the literal directory .tickets-tracker/jira-dig-2529/ happens to exist; it would fail for an alias or a jira_key whose canonical dir is the UUID form.

(3) Standalone scripts (ticket-show.sh, ticket-comment.sh, ticket-edit.sh, ticket-link.sh, ticket-transition.sh, ticket-create.sh) — all do raw dir checks. Direct callers are only TESTS; production goes through ticket-lib-api.sh. Defensive resolve_ticket_id call is desirable for hardening but lower priority.

Other shared-helper bypasses audited — NONE FOUND:
  - write_commit_event: consistently used by ticket-comment/create/edit. ticket-compact inlines git ops with documented rationale (flock nesting).
  - _tag_add / _tag_remove: correctly invoked.
  - Event-file writes: routed through write_commit_event.

Expanded fix plan:
  Phase A. Add _ticketlib_resolve_id in ticket-lib-api.sh — single helper handling 8-hex, 16-hex, jira_key, alias, prefix. Source of truth lives in ticket-lib.sh::resolve_ticket_id; the API-layer helper is a thin wrapper that picks the fast hex path first.
  Phase B. Replace _ticketlib_resolve_short_id calls in all 8 API functions with _ticketlib_resolve_id.
  Phase C. Replace raw dir checks in remaining API functions (ticket_create, etc.) with _ticketlib_resolve_id calls where the input is a user-provided ID (NOT for self-create where the canonical ID was just generated).
  Phase D. Update ticket_read_status in ticket-lib.sh to call resolve_ticket_id internally so ticket_transition becomes correct by design rather than coincidence.
  Phase E. Update ticket_show error contract — emit JSON on stdout with {error,input,message} on lookup miss + non-zero exit; preserve human stderr message (bug 2eea fix).
  Phase F. RED tests covering: jira-style ID for each of the 8 API functions + JSON error contract on miss + ticket_read_status resolution.
